name: auto-claude
description: Finishes a repository's work unattended: Claude plans the long-term end state and its milestones, goal-mode's loop builds each one in a worktree, and auto-claude ships it (push, PR, CI, merge when green), then replans until the final check passes.

ciMode.title: CI mode
ciMode.description: github: push, open a PR, wait for its checks, squash-merge when green. local: run the milestone's check, rebase onto the default branch and push it there. auto: github when gh can see the origin repository

maxRounds.title: Max planning rounds
maxRounds.description: Replans after the queue empties while the final check still fails

maxMerges.title: Max merges per run
maxMerges.description: Stops and reports after this many merges

maxHours.title: Max hours per run
maxHours.description: Stops and reports after this many hours

ciPollSec.title: CI poll interval (s)
ciPollSec.description: How often the driver looks at the loop's log and the open PR
